en.bdb: During the earth quake millions of forts on earth shake and crumble
During the storm, all the trees oscillate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਵਿ ਲਗੈ ਉਜਾੜਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਘਾਹ ਜਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ddav lagai ujaaR vich sabh ghaeh jala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: During fire, all sorts of grass in the forests get burnt.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੜ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਥੰਮੀਅਨਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: haR aae kin tha(n)meean dhareeaau vaha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Who can obstruct flood in the flowing river.
The difficult and foolish task of sewing the torn sky like cloth could be done only by adepts in gossipping.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਗੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਤੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: saa(n)gai a(n)dhar saabate se virale ba(n)dhe ||21||

en.bdb: Rare are the people who remain completely poised during the sham.
